DevOps Testing
DevOps Testing

DevOps Testing
Enable Faster, More Reliable Software Delivery with DevOps Testing
DevOps Testing helps organisations integrate quality assurance throughout the software delivery lifecycle, enabling faster releases without compromising stability or reliability.Market Cloud combines continuous testing, automation, CI/CD integration and quality engineering practices to help teams identify defects earlier, shorten feedback cycles and improve release confidence.
Continuous Quality :
Embed testing into every stage of development and deployment to detect issues earlier.
Faster Feedback :
Provide development teams with rapid test results to support quicker fixes and better decisions.
Release Confidence :
Validate application quality continuously to reduce deployment risk and production issues.
Continuous Testing
Integrate automated testing across development, build and deployment pipelines to validate quality continuously and provide faster feedback.
CI/CD Test Integration
Embed functional, regression, API and automated tests within CI/CD workflows to support reliable and repeatable software delivery.
DevOps Quality Engineering
Combine testing, automation and monitoring practices to improve application quality across development, deployment and production environments.
Explore Market Cloud’s DevOps Testing Capabilities
Continuous Integration Testing
Run automated validation whenever code changes are committed, helping teams identify defects before they move further through the delivery pipeline.
Continuous Delivery Testing
Validate applications throughout deployment stages to ensure releases meet expected quality, functional and stability requirements.
Automated Regression Testing
Execute repeatable regression suites across frequent releases to confirm that new changes do not impact existing functionality.
API & Integration Testing
Validate APIs, services and connected systems continuously to ensure reliable communication across modern application architectures.
Ready to Accelerate Software Delivery with Continuous Testing?
Get a Consultation
Key Process
Assess the Delivery Pipeline
We review your development lifecycle, testing practices, CI/CD pipeline and release requirements to identify quality gaps.
Define the Testing Strategy
We determine the right combination of functional, automated, regression, API and continuous testing for your environment.
Integrate Testing into CI/CD
Testing is embedded into build and deployment pipelines to provide consistent validation throughout the delivery lifecycle.
Automate Critical Validation
We automate repeatable and business-critical test scenarios to reduce manual effort and shorten feedback cycles.
Monitor Quality & Results
Test outcomes, failures and quality indicators are monitored to provide development teams with clear and actionable feedback.
Continuously Improve
Testing coverage, automation and pipeline quality are refined as applications, environments and business requirements evolve.
